reasoning: Tomato leaf showing numerous small (2-4mm) dark brown/black spots uniformly scattered across the surface with distinct yellow chlorotic halos around each spot and general interveinal yellowing. This pattern is diagnostic of Bacterial Speck (Pseudomonas syringae pv. tomato). Septoria is ruled out by absence of white/gray centers and pycnidia; Early Blight ruled out by absence of concentric ring target lesions.
